items.source_en:
It is done. My son, the heretic, is dead, and though a weakness in me wanted him spared, I see now how it was the Great Serpent's will. He Himself sent me Vaeric's executioner in the form of an outsider, an outsider who was able to walk the path and become Promised. The burden has been lifted and my mind is clear.

For the first time, I am able to focus on the Scaled Citadel and the High Council's plan to access it. Was I foolish to put my needs before that of House Sith? Did my inaction put the people of Dreshdae at greater risk? Perhaps, but it was the Great Serpent who laid this test before me, and the Great Serpent who helped me overcome it. I do not doubt this was meant to be, and soon we will uncover the fate of Anasko and House Sith itself.
items.legacy_ko:
결국 끝이 났다. 이단자인 내 아들이 죽은 것이다. 내 나약한 마음은 아들을 살려야 한다고 속삭였지만, 이젠 이것 또한 위대한 뱀의 뜻이었다는 것을 깨닫게 되었다. 뱀께서 직접 내게 배릭의 사형 집행인을 보내주셨고, 그자는 바로 뱀의 길을 걸어 약속받은 자가 된 외부인이었던 것이다. 날 옥죄던 짐은 풀렸고 마음도 이제 또렷해졌다.

처음으로 나는 비늘 성채와 그곳에 접근하려는 대의회의 계획에 집중할 수 있게 되었다. 시스 가문보다 내 가문 사정을 우선시한 것은 어리석은 짓이 아니었을까? 내가 머뭇거린 것 때문에 드레스데 사람들이 더 큰 위험에 빠진 게 아닐까? 아마도... 하지만 이 시험을 내 앞에 놓은 것은 위대한 뱀이셨고, 내가 극복할 수 있도록 도와준 것 또한 위대한 뱀이셨다. 이것 또한 이미 의도하신 바란 것을 의심치 않으며, 곧 우린 아나스코 님과 시스 가문의 운명 자체를 밝혀내고 말 것이다.

items.source_en:
This communication serves to provide a status update on the Kappa site project.

Effective immediately, you are to suspend all activities on the Kappa site project.

Priority is now the reconstruction of our capital. You are ordered to transport as much material as possible to support these efforts.

All personnel are to ensure that, upon departure, maximum feasible quantities of material are transported to support the capital's reconstruction efforts. Additionally, it is imperative that the bunker entrance is in lock down before leaving the site.

Operations on the Kappa site project will resume once the capital's reconstruction is sufficiently underway.

Follow these orders without delay.

The Sith High Council - Lovek Veth'aal

URGENT
